ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes consist of large contiguous high-intensity regions. Low-intensity pixels define the peripheral borders and trailing edge. Specific low-intensity circular clusters are mapped to the upper-left lobe. A vertical chain of low-intensity spots is located directly below the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an obtuse angle (~110 degrees) and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; right lobe features a prominent deep notch 1/3 from the distal tip. Left lobe edge is more uniformly serrated.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, textured, high-intensity clusters (barnacles) mapped to the low-intensity distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent dark linear streak on the right lobe; several smaller, less distinct horizontal marks on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma manifested as irregular edge loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe; barnacle encrustation on distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetric-adjacent dark spots on the left lobe; vertical dotted pigmentation line centered on the lower fluke axis.
